description:
Purpose: harden the completed Google foundation, Gmail, Sheets, Drive, and Calendar packages without live credentials or demos, and prepare the codebase for more Google actions/triggers.

Scope:
- Extract shared offline connector contract tests.
- Normalize Google naming/catalog conventions.
- Unify poller/checkpoint behavior.
- Add explicit scope matrix coverage per package.
- Audit privacy/data-classification boundaries.
- Prepare extension patterns for additional actions/triggers.
- Add offline provider fixture tests from realistic API payloads.

No live tests or demo integration in this epic.
title: [G12] Offline Google Hardening And Expansion Contracts
